rationale: design-import-refactor: generic change landed in Pulp per owner decision 2026-10-04; Vellum inherits (see inheritance ledger); GpuSurface::resize() (gpu_surface_dawn.cpp) now only records the requested size, and begin_frame() configures the swapchain at most once, before it acquires the texture, when the size changed. A zero dimension skips the frame and configures nothing. width()/height() still report the requested size at once. gpu_surface.hpp gains the header-only SwapchainResizeState that decides this and a tail-of-vtable swapchain_stats() configure counter. No present, readback, design-import, Chromium, packaging or authority boundary moves; the Pulp render target has not adopted a Vellum package.
